sources.title: CNCCFP dataset description and stable identifiers

claims.text: The dataset concerns submitted party and grouping accounts. A CNCCFP identifier is retained across a name change when the legal personality is unchanged.
The notice identifies 635 parties and groupings subject to the 2024 reporting obligation.
The official 2024 publication page embeds the comptes_partis-fa.js loader and a table_json display container.
The official loader constructs the table from comptes_partis_<selected exercise>.txt as JSON.

claims.text: The official notice reports 635 filing obligations, 575 accounts submitted and 60 non-filings for 2024.
